name: The Understrand
desc:
The Understrand appears as a rugged hallway that leads to a church-like room with large black pillars and a bright diamond-shaped emblem consisting of multiple lights shining through it.

This area is accessible by using Shadow's Flight or Shadow Travel near certain events. These events are [Silhuett](entity:silhuett) in the [First Layer](location:first_layer) of [the Depths](location:the_depths) or The Ministry Cache event in [The Drowned City of Celtor](location:the_city_of_the_drowned) or [Minityrsa](location:minityrsa).

The Understrand is primarily used for the obtainment of the Deepspindle, Deepscorn Casque and the Darkened Bastion schematic, via the [Ministry Agent](entity:ministry_agent). It is also part of obtaining the Strange Tome Volume 3 for the Bloodfouler quest at a chance if entered through an alternative way.
additional_info:
-   This used to only be accessible in [The Depths](location:the_depths) but became accessible through [Outpost Antumbra](location:outpost_antumbra) and [Minityrsa](location:minityrsa).
-   If you're trying to get here, it's not that ridiculously hard. A great and easy method is to go to [Outpost Antumbra](location:outpost_antumbra) at Minityrsa, and server hop then look around the outpost. Eventually, you will find the purple lights with the dark sigil in the outpost in one of the server. Note that you may need to have a sharp eye to spot the lights, as sometimes they are pretty faint due to the fog. This is less time consuming than having to search the Depths for Silhuett, as you are covering less area, and also less risky as you won't wipe in the Overworld.
-   There will be a pattern on the ground signifying that you have found it its a black circular pattern. The pattern will appear and disappear repeatedly.
-   It is recommended to get shadow travel since getting the desired item may take multiple tries.'
-   When entering in the overworld, the combat theme is Lacrimosa Dies Illa, which is the default combat theme for [The Depths](location:the_depths).
